notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/curvepublishersale_2024
][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/30ee8ddf9c6508d9d0668ff16c01acde47fb3e4c.png[/img][/url]

Our 2024 publisher event is here!
 
Grab your virtual hard hat and step into the bustling assembly line: this is where the magic happens, where code and pixels turn ideas into games that captivate millions of players around the world.
 
Take advantage of the best deals we ever offered, check out our new bundles and discover what games we are carefully putting together for the rest of year!

[h1]FOR THE KING II
[/h1]
We’re excited to bring forth this update as our Q1 Quality of Life update. The main focus of this update was to level up the current set of characters skill sets and kits and make certain characters a bit more fun to play. We also have a whole host of global changes - Find skills can now activate on vehicles, we’ve made some changes to how Taunt works, and the dreaded misclick on the overworld costing you focus can now be refunded! 

We’ve also made broad changes to the in-game encyclopedia, reworked tooltips to provide more pertinent information, added a few new settings, squashed a bunch of bugs and smoothed out a few areas of the game. We are once again asking the Kraken to drop more loot. 

[h1]SPACE CREW
[/h1]
Ready for an out-of-this-world adventure? From March 1st to 13th, dive into Space Crew: Legendary Edition for [b]FREE[/b] and keep it forever!

As we gear up for our upcoming release, Badlands Crew, we invite you to join us on a journey across the cosmos.

Take your chance to explore the stars! The offer ends[b] March 13th![/b]
See you among the galaxies! 🚀


[h1]WOBBLY LIFE
[/h1]
We are delighted to announce that Wobbly Life is now available on [url=https://www.nvidia.com/en-gb/geforce-now/how-to-play/]GeForce Now[/url]!

[b]What GeForce Now is:[
[/b]
GeForce Now allows you to play your games seamlessly on all your devices; transforming your laptop, desktop, Mac, TV, phone into the most powerful method of gaming!

[b]What else is going on?
[/b]
We’re continuing to work hard on our next update which is [b]coming soon[/b]! 
The next update will contain translation of the game in new languages, new costumes from the latest community contest and many more surprises on... and underneath… Wobbly Island.
We can’t wait to share more about our next update and we hope you will love it as much as we do! 🐸

notes.title: Calling all Eco-Warriors, we have the perfect antidote to the climate scaries…
notes.content:
Happy Halloween Mowers!  

It’s time for the [b]Eco Update[/b]! We are pleased to introduce [b]3 new glamping locations[/b], Pear Tree Lodge, Whiteadder Glamping and Foxstone Holiday Park. All locations are ECO only in Career mode, make sure you take a[b]ll-new EGO Mower and EGO Strimmer[/b] to be able to complete these contracts! 

[previewyoutube=SygbLg79DEU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][u]Pear Tree Lodge[/u][/h3]

Pear Tree Lodge has many open areas, a larger deck mower is the key for these parts and for those harder to reach areas they require a strimmer to ensure the most accurate cut. This site has 12 glamping huts, a picnic area and a large rustic fire pit surrounded by log benches. This location was never going to be easy, that’s why they hired an experience mower such as yourself! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171657/8058360bb33f671d382aa29cd08be2e2076c99c8.jpg[/img]


[h3][u]Whiteadder Glamping  [/u][/h3]

Whiteadder Glamping really puts the Glam in Glamping. These pods are raised off the ground with their own private decking area and charging ports, it is best to tackle this with a front mounted deck and strimmer to cut underneath.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171657/be0c6b4f6a03c1d9361604ecc976d585c6b4254d.jpg[/img]


[h3][u]Foxstone Holiday Park  [/u][/h3]

Run by the same owners as Whiteadder Glamping, Foxstone Holiday Park is comprised of raised luxury pods best suited for a front mower. This location has very complex lawns and planting beds to take serious consideration when working on these areas.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171657/9cd8d06d382ddb2d2ac3dae6d6f4cf7d5871a88c.jpg[/img]

As well as this awesome new content update we have added some updates, please see patch notes here:
[list]
[*] Redesigned Career garage UI to be more user friendly
[*] Improved messages around picking up grass piles
[*] Added Borderless windows mode
[*] Fixed an issue with Litter contract times
[*] Fixed an issue where contract result values where inaccurate
[*] Fixed bug where the game could become unresponsive due to employee numbers
[/list]
And if that isn’t reason enough, to celebrate Lawn Mowing Simulator is now 50% off during Curve’s Halloween Sale!  


You can stay up to date with all things Lawn Mowing Simulator by following: 
YouTube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/CurveGamesOfficial]@CurveGames[/url] 
Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/SkyhookGames]@SkyhookGames [/url]

notes.title: Lawn Mowing Simulator – Accessibility Update
notes.content:
Hello, Mowers!

We’re happy to release a new update today for Lawn Mowing Simulator which improves our accessibility offerings!

We’re proud to share these new features below:

[list]
[*] Universal Wheel Support – Steering Wheel support is now available on all platforms
[*] Button Remapping – In-game controls can now be re-mapped on all platforms
[*] Adjustable Text – Font size can now be increased
[*] Steering Wheel On/Off – Any input classified as a “Joystick” (Unrecognised Wheels, Flight Sticks) can now be turned off and on (This does not include Keyboard/Mouse/Gamepads)
[/list]

With this update, we’re also very excited to announce that Lawn Mowing Simulator is now Steam Deck Verified! Now that’s Mow-bility!

A huge thank you to our incredible community for your support and feedback!

For all things Lawn Mowing Simulator, be sure to follow us on Twitter, and join our Discord!
Have a great day


Skyhook Games

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.10.0
notes.content:
v1.0.10.0 update patch (bug-fix) is now available on all platforms.  From all of the team, a massive thank you to all of our players for support and feedback!  We’re committed to continuing to improve Lawn Mowing Simulator and your feedback in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/lawnmowingsim]Discord [/url]server, as well as on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1480560/discussions/]forums [/url]and on [url=https://twitter.com/SkyhookGames/]Twitter[/url], is really appreciated!
 
[b]Gameplay[/b]

-	Fixed an issue where the Knight OFT mower occasionally spawned in an incorrect position
-	Fixed an issue where some mowers in specific circumstances wouldn’t allow players to get on them
-	Improved the likelihood of Ancient Britain contracts appearing in a player’s Career
-	Fixed various third-person camera clipping issues
-	Fixed an issue where too high a damage penalty might be given after a collision
-	Re-balanced various Challenges

[b]UI[/b]

-	Fixed an issue where a rogue menu could appear under certain circumstances on Windows
-	Fixed an issue where the Scag V-Ride II prompt may have been impossible to dismiss
-	Improved the functionality of backing through the New Career flow

[b]Other[/b]

-	Resolved cloud saving issues on Windows
-	Fixed an issue where an incorrect background may display when in the garage
-	Improved various object lighting
-	Fixed an issue where grass bags appeared to be floating on some contracts
 

Once again – a massive thank you all!

Skyhook Games

notes.title: Ancient Britain DLC is out!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We are thrilled to announce the launch of our first DLC [b]Ancient Britain[/b] on Steam today. With this DLC, you will be able to explore quintessentially British ruins whilst peacefully mowing the lawns of these sites. Ancient Britain is available at £6.99 / €8.99 / $8.99; you can find out more [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685910/Lawnmowing_Simulator__Ancient_Britain/]here[/url] on Steam.

We have also added [b]String Trimmers[/b] (AKA Weedwhackers) in the game for free! An essential new tool which we hope will allow you to grow and become a master of your craft!   

Our [b]latest patch[/b] is also going live today on Steam. Please find our patch notes below. We would like to remind everyone that we are committed to ensuring the highest quality game for our players and hope these bugfixes improve your game play. 
Thank you as always for your continued support and feedback. If there is anything you feel we haven’t addressed, please join our Discord and let us know – https://discord.com/invite/lawnmowingsim 

We hope you will enjoy this update! 

- The Grass Team (Lawn Mowing Simulator Team) 
 

[h1] ANCIENT BRITAIN DLC [/h1] 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685910/Lawnmowing_Simulator__Ancient_Britain/]The Ancient Britain DLC[/url] contains [b]four brand new locations[/b] each coming with its new challenges and inviting you to peacefully mown iconic British sites: 

[list] 
    [*][b]The Royal Stones [/b]
Here you will find quite a whimsical place, with two stone circles - their historical significance continues to be debated, but one thing is for certain, they could use a tidy up! Using the tools at your disposal and the new string trimmers, it is your task to go around these ancient ruins and carefully tidy it up.  

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171657/7a9935ec1ce1ece0a8c42d8a02a154bfe3aa7ebe.jpg[/img]


    [*][b]Druid's Tor [/b]
Hidden in a quiet valley lie these ancient megaliths, forgotten by the modern world. Do your bit in bringing this site back to life! 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171657/cac090bb0d7564a7b263c13e7c674616c5d4522e.jpg[/img]


    [*][b]The Ancient Aurochs [/b]
One of Britain's oldest inns, this charming setting seems to be the perfect place to spend the day mowing.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171657/a09b27ff0dbdb9bea595922ef3399e1c97f2261b.jpg[/img]
 

    [*][b]Aurochs Hill [/b]
A fascinating site that is home to a Bronze-Age field painting. Set on a steep slope with an intricate cut pattern around the painting, this may be your toughest task yet. Be sure to go slow as any damage caused to this historic site will come with a heavy fine.  

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171657/b9aa8c5ee0a883e1b0315b5078fe4d903b16c8e1.jpg[/img]

 
[/list] 
[h1] FREE STRING TRIMMERS UPDATE [/h1] 

[b]Three new String Trimmers[/b] are now available in the game, and for free! These essential lawncare tools will allow you to cut the grass more easily in those awkward areas. Ensuring you stay away from damage fines and produce the best work yet. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171657/a194935e5bb6b6724bf454c6bc2fe50a7384c9bf.jpg[/img]


[h1] PATCH NOTES [/h1] 
[list] 

    [*]Fixed an issue where mowers might lose functionality during mowing 
    [*]Fixed an issue where an infinite load may occur when loading the Test Drive area 
    [*]Improved legibility on 480p resolution screens 
    [*]Fixed an issue where changing language in-game didn't apply immediately 
    [*]Fixed an issue where a tree had inaccurate collision 
    [*]Fixed an issue where prompts were shown on the wrong grass incorrectly 
    [*]Fixed an issue where inaccurate lighting may have occurred under limited circumstances 
    [*]Fixed an issue with flickering lights and shadows may have occurred 
    [*]Fixed an issue where changing the speaker mode reset all sound settings to default 
    [*]Fixed an issue where bankruptcy warning messages were overlapping 
    [*]Fixed an issue where the Groundmaster 3300's steering wheel may have displayed incorrectly 
    [*]Fixed an issue where the first person camera would reset its position upon using ProView 
    [*]Fixed an issue where cameras could clip through hedges, trees and buildings 
    [*]Fixed an issue where incorrect litter contract rewards were received 
    [*]Fixed an issue where the player avatar would not look left or right on the Scag V-Ride 
    [*]Fixed an issue where grass occasionally would not deform as intended 

    [*]All vehicles motor load rebalanced 

    [*]All Career contract times updated to fit new strimmer gameplay loop 

    [*]All Challenge times updated to fit new strimmer gameplay loop 

    [*]Fixed a bug where the 3300 72" deck was not cutting to the correct width 

    [*]Fixed a bug where the 3300 72” deck castor wheels were not moving 

 

[/list] 

 

You can stay up to date with all things Lawn Mowing Simulator by following:

notes.title: Lawn Mowing Simulator – Update 3 SCAG V-Ride II Now Available
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It’s certainly been quite a ride since launch, and we’d like to thank you for your continued support and for continuing to give us your feedback!

Today we’ve got a special announcement for you:

[b]Lawn Mowing Simulator – Update 3[/b]

Leading the way for Update 3 is the new playable mower:

[i]The SCAG V-Ride II[/i]

The addition of the SCAG V-Ride II sees the first ever stander type vehicle added to Lawn Mowing Simulator’s ever-growing roster of mowers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171657/17fc7275fc496433b265183423176b22528d558b.jpg[/img]

The SCAG V-Ride II is a compact, fast and agile stand-on mowing machine. It combines the speed and comfort of a zero turn with the space-saving convenience of a walk-behind mower, perfect for tight locations with limited accessibility.

The SCAG V-Ride II will set you back £9,300 in Career mode (which then unlocks it in Free Mow), has 13 cut height settings from 1.5” up to 4.5” and has a top speed of 10.5mph… which feels pretty damn fast when you are stood up!

Alongside this new addition we’ve also fixed some minor bugs and made some optimisation tweaks.

Thank you once again and we hope you enjoy the NEW SCAG V-Ride II!

notes.title: V1.0.2.0 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to our second patch for Lawn Mowing Simulator since our launch. We've been toiling away in the background on this patch while we prep some great things that we can hopefully share with you very soon! Thank you for your continued support and for continuing to give us your feedback across our Discord channel - if you haven't yet joined, please do!

Without further ado please see our patch notes below; V1.0.2.0

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]
[list]
[h1]Functionality[/h1]
[*] Added the Patterson RO-A mower to unlock in career mode
[*] Added Cruise Control to help users that use keyboard and mouse to regulate mower speed
[*] Added further ranks to the RP system at the top end
[*] Added three new challenges related to the Patterson RO-A mower
[*] Raised the maximum number of employees from 2 to 4
[*] Added a notification informing users on a mower that they can get off the mower if they choose to
[*] Added Steam Cloud Saving Functionality/Support

[h1]Bug-Fixes[/h1]
[*] Updated how employee contracts work so that if the user quits their contract, the employee only receives the same percentage of their contract
[*] Updated tree collision to more accurately match trees
[*] Updated all contract values to be rebalanced throughout Career Mode
[*] Fixed an issue where interest rates ingame always displayed at 10%
[*] Fixed an issue where on occasion Projected Earnings moved onto two lines
[*] Fixed an issue where a yellow tick would display next to the Company Name input field without the user entering a company name
[*] Fixed an issue where some elements of the HUD were using a different shade of red
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing ‘Pause’ after purchasing a HQ could cause the UI to disappear
[*] Fixed an issue where wrong grass could be mowable and highlighted by ProView
[*] Fixed an issue where the user could only interact with up to 10 collectible objects per contract
[*] Fixed an issue where opening the Pause menu whilst specific prompts were displayed would cause a UI malfunction
[*] Fixed an issue where a softlock may occur after completing a litter contract
[*] Fixed an issue where ‘Recommended Cut Time’ text would be replaced with ‘Cutting Time Limit’
[*] Fixed an issue whereby mower damage would periodically not apply when being used by an employee
[*] Fixed an issue whereby RP was periodically shown as incorrect for an employee contract
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing ‘Enter’ in the Settings menu periodically wouldn’t apply settings changes correctly
[*] Fixed an issue whereby after returning from the Pause menu a mower’s roller would be disengaged
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the user couldn’t change the cut height using a Logitech G29 wheel
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the user couldn’t control the player using the Logitech G29 wheel
[*] Fixed an issue whereby an incorrect control scheme may be displayed when using a wheel
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the Pause menu may not be functional if the user exited Test Drive early
[*] Fixed an issue where user input was still accepted during the cutscene shown after purchasing a HQ
[*] Fixed an issue where black patches periodically appeared on cut grass
[*] Fixed an issue whereby valuables would occasionally appear multiple times
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the collector of the Turf Tiger II may not fill up correctly
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the third person camera would clip through scenery occasionally
[*] Fixed an issue whereby grass would not be affected by the mower occasionally if the blade condition was low
[*] Fixed an issue whereby ground damage and grass clippings where sometimes not taken into calculation of fines during challenges
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the Knight OFT may bounce aggressively after hitting the trailer’s ramp
[*] Updated localisation strings throughout

[/list]We have exciting and great things on the horizon, stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171657/7599ae01b5d450a4e6bd5d5a647071c62b2921f9.jpg[/img]

Until next time!

notes.title: V1.0.0.10 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to our first patch for Lawn Mowing Simulator since our launch. Our first week has been a busy one with thousands of you joining our Discord and giving us feedback on the game. We're absolutely floored by the support we've received so far and rest assured we will continue addressing and expanding Lawn Mowing Simulator as we move forward - and will have plenty of new information soon!

Please see below, our patch notes for the now live patch; V1.0.0.10

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a windowed/full-screen toggle in the Display Settings menu
[*] Added support for ultra-wide monitors in the Display Settings menu
[*] Added separate options in the Control Settings menu for inverting the Y-axis for 'first person on mower', 'third person on mower' and 'first person off mower' individually
[*] Added a stripe roller button callout in the Control screen
[*] Added a stripe roller notification during gameplay
[*] Added new loan interest amounts (Please Note: This will only affect new loans taken after the patch, not existing loans)
[*] Fixed an issue where using the pause menu in Test Drive rendered the pause menu non-functional in future contracts
[*] Fixed an issue where inverting the Y-axis reverted back to OFF when the user confirmed the setting change
[*] Fixed an issue where achievements were not saving between sessions and would reset on each session load
[*] Fixed numerous mower deck width descriptions that were incorrect
[*] Fixed an issue with collision on Castle tower
[/list]

Please continue to give us your feedback either here or on Discord!

Until next time!

notes.title: Lawn Mowing Simulator Wheel Support Update!
notes.content:
Hello all!  

We’re just a few days out from launch and we’re here to deliver you an exciting update on our Wheel Support for Lawn Mowing Simulator. 

Throughout our campaign, from the moment we debuted our game right through to our rounds of demo feedback we’ve heard one thing over and over – can I play Lawn Mowing Simulator with my wheel?!  

Until now we’ve given you the statement of “We’re working on it for launch!” but we’re now happy to say that on PC from August 10th you will be able to experience the physicality of Lawn Mowing Simulator on a range of Wheels and Pedals. This includes full Logitech TRUEFORCE support for their wheels, allowing you to truly feel the mower beneath your hands. 

We will continue to add support for more wheels as we go, please let us know if there is a wheel which you use that isn't on the list and we can prioritise our support for peripherals. 

[b]The following wheels are officially supported for Lawn Mowing Simulator on Steam on August 10th: [/b]
[list][*] LOGITECH G920 Wheel and Pedal 
[*] LOGITECH G29 Wheel and Pedal 
[*] LOGITECH G923 Wheel and Pedal (PlayStation Version)  
[*] LOGITECH G923 Wheel and Pedal (Xbox Version) 
[*] LOGITECH FARM SIMULATOR Wheel and Pedal 
[/list] [b]Button Input Comparison Graph: [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171657/08bb3a5f9526817ce084977b008af0e3676f9f1e.png[/img]
Please click [url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40171657/08bb3a5f9526817ce084977b008af0e3676f9f1e.png]here[/url] for the full-size image.

We’re continuing to work hard to meet your expectations with Lawn Mowing Simulator, the launch of this title on Tuesday is just the beginning for us, and we hope you’ll join us on our journey in creating the most authentic Lawn Mowing Simulator ever!

If you haven't already, please throw us a wishlist on Steam, and see you Tuesday!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Feedback & Changes!
notes.content:
Hello all! 

Hope you’re doing well! We want to thank everyone for all their feedback and support throughout the demo period and beyond. We’re thrilled and absolutely blown away to say that we had a total of over a quarter of a million downloads of the Lawn Mowing Simulator Demo across both Steam and Xbox, this was alongside over 3.5 million views across YouTube and Twitch, and countless other social media posts that were gaining traction over the demo week. We can’t thank everyone enough for being a part of this ride, and we truly hope you’ll stick with us through to launch and beyond, also join our Discord if you haven’t already! 

Below is the list of the most reported bugs and issues that occurred during the demo, listed in priority order – with some offering some more information about the intended use/fix - this priority order dictates somewhat the order in which things will be fixed/changed. So, with some of the below stating specifics around the launch date, you might be wondering “When is the launch day?!” Well, you’ll just have to wait until next week when will be announcing when our launch date is! 

[u][b]High Priority [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Mouse not locked to screen 
[*] Mouse not disabled when using controller 
[*] Mouse pointer visible during gameplay when using M&K 
[*] No Motion Blur control
We apologise for this issue affecting some of you very negatively during the demo period – this issue is also exacerbated by lower framerate/performance, but we’re aiming to add a toggle for this. 
[*]Changing uniform/hat colour bug - does not let you pick a colour. 
[*]Non-US keyboard mapping error 
[*]Imperial/Metric conversion Error  
[/list]

[u][b]Medium Priority[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Ultra-Wide Support/Multi-Monitor Support not working as intended. 
[*] Expanded graphics options   
[*] Fonts too small for on-screen prompts (4K TVs?) 
[*] Imperial/Metric conversion should ideally use decimals rather than fractions  
[/list]
 
[u][b]Low Priority [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] S/D buttons too sensitive for turning 
We’ve been researching many similar Simulator games throughout development and seeing how they also handle keyboard steering and we’re seeing results that aren’t too dissimilar from where our title currently sits – obviously the best way to play the game in our opinion is with a controller or wheel (when it is added) and so we imagine the number of people playing with a keyboard would likely be quite low in the grand scheme of things. We will continue to investigate this issue as we progress through to launch and beyond. 
[*] Longer Name field for Company Name  
We had several people reach out about this issue and while this does seem like a ‘simple’ issue, there’s some real ramifications for extending this field in terms of text-bleed and overages that can occur when making this field longer. 
[/list]

[u][b]Already fixed [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Disappearing Mower Glitch - Mower disappears from trailer completely after loading in/navigating the location.  
As you may have seen, this finicky physics bug was causing havoc all over our fictional town! Please enjoy this tweet from @NeatWolf complete with horrific video as he squashed this bug: 
https://twitter.com/NeatWolf/status/1408105626937565192
[*] Missing tutorial for lowering deck 
Many of you may have experienced this as ‘The Knight OFS1 won’t cut the grass!’ or similar. Rest assured this was the tutorial just not doing due diligence informing you about lowering the deck! 
[*] Camera/Mouse Acceleration too sensitive  
[*] Default cut height key bindings need swapping  
While this issue was observed by some, we are planning to add full key remapping, so that users can change any of their keys around as they please. 
[*] Invert Y axis does not work for Item Collection mode 
[/list]

[u][b]Feedback/Further Additions:  
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Steering Wheel Support – Planned for release in Launch Day patch or ASAP after. 
We’re still very much in the ‘we want to do this for launch and are trying our hardest to make that happen!’ but we can’t say for sure right now the exact date this will occur, we'll let you know as soon as we know! 
[*] Further Additions to be confirmed for the future post-launch: 
Multiplayer additions 
Weed whackers/Strimmers 
Walk-behind mowers 
More mowers 
Mid-contract saving 
[/list]

notes.title: Xbox Insider Performance & Feedback + Steam Next Fest PC Demo Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello all!

First of all, allow me to thank you all for joining us here at Steam and on our Discord: discord.gg/lawnmowingsim , from our announcement at the end of March. It’s been fantastic conversing with all of you, answering your questions and feeling your excitement regarding the product. While we don’t have a release date yet, we want to assure everyone that we all have an exciting few months ahead of us, and we hope you’ll continue with us on the journey!

It’s been around a month since the Xbox Insider Programme ended, and to all those who filled in the surveys, communicated and told others about the game, gave the Xbox Insider Programme a go, thank you so very much. We found the Xbox Insider Programme, our first one ever, extremely valuable! Not only did it form the foundation of our announcement, but it also gave everyone a taste of what is to come when we launch this Summer. But we’re not just here to thank you, we also have a few things to share with you today… 

[h1]Xbox Insider Results, Game Changes and More[/h1]
We’re extremely happy with the results of the Insider Programme - as you know we’ve been enjoying your questions in the #Ask-The-Devs Discord channel, as well as asking you more about specifics in various other parts of the Discord. The Discord, in combination with the huge amount of data we received from Xbox containing valuable game feedback has fed into our plans going into launch and updates post-release. More details on that soon!

As well as raising some bugs that we have since fixed, the Xbox Insider allowed us to gauge the demand for many of the features we have already started working on, and have reprioritised our work to factor in and meet that demand - one such example being the rebalancing of the career economy allowing players for more gameplay paths earlier on in your experience.  Also, we are making many Quality of Life improvements - such as improving tutorialisation, camera sensitivity options, axis inversion and text legibility, and this is all based on the Insider Programme feedback. 

The Xbox Insider Programme has proved invaluable as we reach the end of development on Lawn Mowing Simulator. We feel that now, more than ever, we know our audience way more as a result of the programme, and we can prioritise updates and improvements that you all want to see moving forward. 

[h1]But What’s Next?[/h1]
One of the big requests coming out of the Discord was for [b]PC users to[/b] get in early on the action too. To that end, we’re really excited and happy to let you know that there’ll be a Steam demo of Lawn Mowing Simulator coming out on [b]16th June and running as part of the Steam Next Festival until 22nd June. [/b]

Like last time, we will set up bespoke areas on [b]Discord [/b]and a[b] Google Form[/b] for everyone who wants to take part in the PC demo, and we would love any and all feedback!

Over the coming weeks we will be dropping some [b]bespoke Manufacturer content trailers[/b] that showcase some of the Lawn Mowers within our game, and keep an eye out as we look to[b] engage a wide range of YouTubers and Twitch Streamers [/b]across both platforms leading up to the Festivals. We’re really keen on getting the word out about Lawn Mowing Simulator and the community we have building here! If you’re a YouTuber or Twitch Streamer who would love to try our the game, please let us know at: PR@curve-digital.com and pass us your details such as channel name, confirmation of email address on channel and so on.

Finally, if you haven’t already - please give us a wishlist and a follow on Steam as that helps us out on the algorithm a lot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480560/Lawn_Mowing_Simulator/

Many Thanks
